requirements.requirement: The system must include a unit test validating that a RECRUITING status maps to the highest configured score.
The system must include a unit test validating that an ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING status maps to a lower score than RECRUITING.
The system must include a unit test validating that a COMPLETED status maps to a lower score than ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING.
The system must include a unit test validating that a TERMINATED status maps to the lowest defined score among known statuses.
The system must include a unit test validating that an UNKNOWN status maps to the default fallback score defined in the schema.
The system must include a unit test validating deterministic output such that identical input status values always produce identical scores.
The system must include a unit test validating that status values are handled case-insensitively if normalization is expected by the scoring logic.
The system must include a unit test validating behavior when the status field is null, ensuring a safe fallback score is returned.
The system must include a unit test validating behavior when the status field is missing from the input payload, ensuring no exception is thrown and a fallback score is returned.
The system must include a unit test validating that unrecognized status strings map to the UNKNOWN category score.
The system must include a unit test validating that all defined status categories from the schema are covered by at least one test case.
The system must ensure unit tests execute within the backend test suite without requiring external API calls or network access.
